claims.text: Soluna Holdings announced on October 21st, 2026 that it had entered a definitive agreement to form a jointly owned company with Applied Digital Corporation.
claims.quote: today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement (the “Transaction Agreement”) to form a jointly owned company (the “Project Company”) with Applied Digital Corporation (NASDAQ: APLD)
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: The joint company is to develop a planned 50 MW critical IT data center for AI and HPC at Project Dorothy 3. Soluna describes the site as near Silverton in Briscoe County.
claims.quote: to develop a planned 50 MW critical IT data center for AI and HPC (the “Project”) at Project Dorothy 3, Soluna’s development site near Silverton (Briscoe County) Texas
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: Soluna says that after closing Applied is expected to hold a 51% interest in the joint company and Soluna the remaining 49%.
claims.quote: Applied is expected to hold a 51% interest in the Project Company, and Soluna is expected to hold the remaining 49% interest
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: Closing depends on conditions that include approval of a tax abatement for the project in Briscoe County.
claims.quote: subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions precedent, including the approval of a tax abatement for the Project in Briscoe County, Texas
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: Soluna expects the transactions to close by the end of the calendar year.
claims.quote: The transactions are expected to close by the end of the calendar year.
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: Soluna describes Briscoe Wind as a 150 MW wind farm in Briscoe County. Dorothy 3 is planned as an AI data center beside it.
claims.quote: Dorothy 3 is a planned AI data center co-located with Briscoe Wind, a 150 MW wind farm in Briscoe County, Texas
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: Phase 1 of Dorothy 3 is the 50 MW critical IT phase. Soluna expects it to draw power from both Briscoe Wind and the grid, subject to definitive documentation.
claims.quote: Subject to definitive documentation, Phase 1 of Dorothy 3 (50 MW Critical IT) is expected to draw power from both Briscoe Wind and the grid.
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: ChronoScale Holdings is majority owned by Applied. It has signed a non-binding letter of intent to lease the planned facility.
claims.quote: a publicly-traded company majority-owned by Applied (“ChronoScale”), has signed a non-binding letter of intent to lease the planned facility
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: Soluna states there is no assurance that a definitive lease with ChronoScale will be signed on the terms of the letter of intent or at all.
claims.quote: there can be no assurance that a definitive lease will be entered into on the terms contemplated by the letter of intent, or at all
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: Soluna CEO John Belizaire said the company was built to bring load to the generation so the power would be ready when demand arrived.
claims.quote: We built Soluna to bring load to the generation, so the power would be ready when the demand arrived.
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: Belizaire said the constraint in AI is energy access rather than chips.
claims.quote: We have said for a long time that the constraint in AI is energy access, not chips
claims.document: Soluna Agrees to Form Strategic Partnership with Applied Digital to Develop Wind-Powered AI Data Center in Texas

claims.text: Soluna describes Project Dorothy as a 100 MW wind-powered campus built behind the meter at the 150 MW Briscoe Wind Farm. Soluna says it acquired the wind farm in April 2026.
claims.quote: Project Dorothy is a 100 MW wind-powered campus in Briscoe County, Texas, built behind the meter at the 150 MW Briscoe Wind Farm, which Soluna acquired in April 2026.
claims.document: Soluna Secures Conditional Base Load Position for Project Dorothy's 100 MW in ERCOT Batch Zero

claims.text: In its September 14th, 2026 release Soluna said Dorothy 1 and Dorothy 2 have 98 MW of energized capacity.
claims.quote: Dorothy 1 and Dorothy 2 account for 98 MW of energized capacity.
claims.document: Soluna Secures Conditional Base Load Position for Project Dorothy's 100 MW in ERCOT Batch Zero

claims.text: Soluna calls Dorothy 3 the 300 MW next phase of the campus and says it is designed for AI and high performance computing.
claims.quote: Project Dorothy 3, the 300 MW next phase on the campus, is designed for AI and high-performance computing.
claims.document: Soluna Secures Conditional Base Load Position for Project Dorothy's 100 MW in ERCOT Batch Zero

claims.text: Soluna says ERCOT conditionally classified the 100 MW Project Dorothy campus as Base Load in Batch Zero.
claims.quote: ERCOT has conditionally classified its 100 MW Project Dorothy campus as Base Load in Batch Zero
claims.note: The company's own account of an ERCOT action, not checked against an ERCOT source.
claims.document: Soluna Secures Conditional Base Load Position for Project Dorothy's 100 MW in ERCOT Batch Zero

claims.text: Soluna says the classification is conditional until ERCOT completes its verification process. ERCOT may remove a project from Batch Zero if the applicant does not respond to its information requests.
claims.quote: The classification is conditional pending completion of ERCOT’s ongoing verification process, under which ERCOT may remove a project from Batch Zero if the applicant does not respond to its information requests.
claims.document: Soluna Secures Conditional Base Load Position for Project Dorothy's 100 MW in ERCOT Batch Zero

claims.text: Soluna says a further request for 50 MW at the Dorothy campus is already under study.
claims.quote: An additional 50 MW request at the campus is already under study
claims.document: Soluna Secures Conditional Base Load Position for Project Dorothy's 100 MW in ERCOT Batch Zero

claims.text: Soluna announced on August 24th, 2026 that it had closed the purchase of 397 acres in Briscoe County.
claims.quote: today announced it has closed the purchase of 397 acres in Briscoe County, Texas
claims.document: Soluna Closes Purchase of 397 Acres for Project Dorothy

claims.text: Soluna says the land will host Dorothy 3, a planned AI campus with potential capacity of up to 300 MW.
claims.quote: The land will host Project Dorothy 3, Soluna’s planned renewable-first AI computing campus with a potential capacity of up to 300 MW.
claims.document: Soluna Closes Purchase of 397 Acres for Project Dorothy

claims.text: Soluna says the wind farm substation sits directly across from the property. The company says this positions Dorothy 3 for direct behind-the-meter access to generation it owns outright.
claims.quote: The Briscoe Wind Farm’s Substation sits directly across from the acquired property, positioning Dorothy 3 for direct, behind-the-meter access to generation the Company owns outright.
claims.document: Soluna Closes Purchase of 397 Acres for Project Dorothy

claims.text: Soluna says the 397 acres exceed the 300 acres it first identified for the campus. The extra land leaves room for more data halls if further generation or storage becomes available.
claims.quote: The 397 acres exceed the 300 acres Soluna originally identified for the campus. The additional land gives the Company room to add data halls should further generation or storage capacity become available at the site.
claims.document: Soluna Closes Purchase of 397 Acres for Project Dorothy

claims.text: The Public Notices page on the Briscoe County website lists a document titled Tax Abatement Guidelines and Criteria beside its Commissioners Court agendas.
claims.quote: TAX ABATEMENT - GUIDELINES AND CRITERIA
claims.document: Briscoe County Texas, Public Notices & News

rejected.finding: Briscoe County contact details for residents
rejected.reason: The county pages load, but no verbatim string of four words or more proves a phone, address or email, since each sits on its own short line.

rejected.finding: A county record of an abatement application or agenda item for the Soluna and Applied project
rejected.reason: The Public Notices page names neither company. The October 13th and October 16th, 2026 Commissioners Court agendas are scans listing no abatement item. The October 13th agenda lists an economic development executive session that names no project.
The host did not resolve. The working county host is www.co.briscoe.tx.us.
